description: This Java interface defines the CalculatedFieldConfiguration with various annotations for JSON serialization/deserialization, Swagger documentation, and methods related to calculated field configurations in the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldConfiguration
classes.description: A Java interface representing configuration for calculated fields with multiple subtype mappings and utility methods.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the calculated field.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Retrieves the output configuration for the calculated field.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Default method for validation, can be overridden.

methods.name: getReferencedEntities
methods.description: Default method returning an empty set of referenced entities.

methods.name: buildCalculatedFieldLink
methods.description: Builds a CalculatedFieldLink object from tenant, referenced entity, and calculated field IDs.

methods.name: buildCalculatedFieldLinks
methods.description: Builds a list of CalculatedFieldLinks for all referenced entities except the current entity.

methods.name: requiresScheduledReevaluation
methods.description: Indicates if the calculated field requires scheduled reevaluation; defaults to false.
